verdict.rationale: Kommo markets itself as an AI-powered CRM, so letting its AI features call tools from external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP or connecting MCP servers. The integrations, Web SDK, webhooks, SalesBot and llms.txt items are adjacent developer building blocks, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
